description: Understands requests, decomposes work, and routes subtasks.
Explains access decisions while deterministic RBAC enforces them.
Retrieves authorized enterprise document chunks and grounds responses.
Queries employee, leave, attendance, skill, and workload records.
Queries projects, tasks, dependencies, risks, and team allocations.
Analyzes customers, products, orders, channels, regions, and profit.
Handles purchase, expense, threshold, and financial-policy workflows.
Checks correctness, grounding, safety, and workflow completeness.
Produces evidence, rationale, confidence, and agent-trace summaries.
Creates, pauses, resumes, and records human approvals.
Aggregates latency, success, cost, hallucination, and review metrics.
